vopros: What is Remote CFO & Accounting Solutions in Tampa, and what do they do?

vyzhimka.tekst:
Remote CFO & Accounting Solutions, LLC is a Tampa, Florida-based financial-services business. Florida corporate records show that it was formed in November 2021 and remains active as of its 2026 annual report. Julia Dospehoff is listed as the company’s manager and registered agent, with its principal address in Tampa. ([search.sunbiz.org](https://search.sunbiz.org/Inquiry/CorporationSearch/GetDocument?aggregateId=flal-l21000488130-2e624945-25aa-449f-880a-4bfffb23ecbb&formatType=PDF&transactionId=l21000488130-a17b9744-6e6b-4621-89f9-f0f2d6471403&utm_source=openai))

There’s relatively little detailed public information about the firm itself online, so I wouldn’t want to attribute services to it that I can’t verify. Based on its name and positioning, it appears to operate as an outsourced/remote accounting and CFO-services firm—essentially providing businesses with financial-management expertise without requiring them to employ a full-time CFO or accounting department. Firms in this category commonly handle bookkeeping/accounting, financial reporting, budgeting and forecasting, cash-flow management, and higher-level CFO guidance.

There is also some independent evidence connecting Julia Dospehoff with the business: local professional-network listings identify her with “Remote CFO & Accounting Solutions,” and one Tampa-area business owner describes having worked with her for years and characterizes her as professional, detail-oriented, and knowledgeable. ([alignable.com](https://www.alignable.com/temple-terrace-fl/jules-creative-llc?utm_source=openai))

So, in practical terms, this looks like a small Tampa-based outsourced finance/accounting practice rather than a large accounting firm. Its Florida entity is legitimate and currently active, but I’m not finding a substantial corporate website or public service catalog that lets me independently verify exactly which accounting/CFO services it currently offers.

If you're asking because you’re considering hiring them, working for them, or received a communication/invoice from them, I can also investigate their business history, owner, reviews, online presence, and any potential red flags.
